summary: Full frontend verification of the four new enhancements (Key/Harmonic Match, Loop Roll Pads, Waveform Overview, Auto-Cue Next) at 1920x1080. Seeded license via localStorage, created a playlist, uploaded 3 tonal WAVs (/tmp/a220.wav 220Hz@120bpm, /tmp/b330.wav 330Hz@130bpm, /tmp/c440.wav 440Hz@140bpm), then clicked track-list-panel to satisfy the AudioContext gesture. All four features render and function without runtime errors. Regression flows (standby take/sync/nudge/lock, fader curves, crossfader, BPM column, /live page) intact.

issues: Pre-existing dev-only hydration warning: <span> injected inside <option> by x-source instrumentation. Not related to new features.

critical_code_review_comments: audioEngine.bpmFor now computes BOTH bpm+key and fires onBpm(id,bpm,key); App.js handler stores camelot/keyName only if not already set — good idempotency.

toggleRoll uses setInterval with intervalMs = (60/bpm)*rollDiv*1000 clamped to >=50ms; stopRoll clears interval and pauses audio; jingleActive resets when both rolls and active jingles are empty — correct.
onCommit fires new-index auto-cue guarded by autoCueRef and missingIdsRef; verified track 2 (c440) was auto-armed after TAKE with auto-cue ON.
standbyHarmonic derived via camelotCompatible only when both camelots present; renders green 'HARMONIC ✓' or amber 'CLASH' — no null-crash path.
deck-waveforms wrapper is gated `hidden lg:flex` — by design not visible below lg (~1024px); confirmed visible at 1920px.
seed_data_creation: Generated /tmp/a220.wav, /tmp/b330.wav, /tmp/c440.wav — 8s mono sine tones at 220/330/440 Hz with soft beat-click envelope at 120/130/140 BPM so both key and BPM detectors have signal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /tmp/{a220,b330,c440}.wav for key/harmonic/auto-cue tests. Seed localStorage['hotlive95_license'] before navigation. A single click on track-list-panel is enough to resume AudioContext and let bpmFor decode+analyze. Camelot cells populate within ~1s after gesture; standby-harmonic and track-harmonic-{i} render only when both compared tracks have a camelot. deck-waveforms is only mounted at lg width or wider.

verified_features.key_camelot: track-key-0='8A', track-key-1='9A', track-key-2='8A' within 1s of gesture
verified_features.harmonic_flag: standby-harmonic='♪ HARMONIC ✓'; track-harmonic-1 and track-harmonic-2 present; track-harmonic-0 correctly absent (that's the on-air track)
verified_features.loop_roll: jingle-roll-0 present after assigning /tmp/a220.wav to pad 0; toggle applies hl-roll-active + bg-[var(--hl-fire)]; all 4 roll-div buttons (1, ½, ¼, ⅛) present and clickable
verified_features.waveform_overview: deck-waveforms visible at 1920px with AIR (peaks rendered) and CUE (peaks rendered) mini-waveforms after play+arm
verified_features.auto_cue_next: auto-cue-next-toggle turns amber ON. Before TAKE standby-track-name='b330'; after TAKE with auto-cue ON, standby-track-name='c440' (track 2 auto-armed) — no crash
verified_features.regression: standby-sync/nudge-fwd/nudge-back/sync-lock, fader-curve-smooth/sharp, crossfader-rail/cap, track-bpm-{0,1,2} populated (120/129/140), /live page loads and shows NOW PLAYING b330 / UP NEXT c440
